title: REST API reference docs: gateway passthrough endpoints are documented by hand in docs/api_reference/source/rest-api.rst with a fastapi<METHOD><path> anchor
answers: Where do I document a new gateway passthrough endpoint in the REST API reference?
How are the REST API doc anchors named for POST endpoints under /gateway?
Where is the typesafe or OpenAI passthrough endpoint section in the API docs?
Which file lists the gateway endpoint tables and their HTTP methods?
body:
Path: docs/api_reference/source/rest-api.rst is the hand-maintained REST API reference. Gateway passthrough endpoints (for example the OpenAI passthrough responses section and the Typesafe passthrough system-one section) each get their own heading, an endpoint/HTTP method table, and a short description.
Rule: Add a new gateway passthrough endpoint as a section in this file, with a label of the form .. _fastapiPOST<path with slashes removed> (for example fastapiPOSTgatewaytypesafev1systemone for /gateway/typesafe/v1/systemone), a title, a grid table with the endpoint in literal backticks, and a description that says which gateway endpoint's credentials and model are used.
Constraints: Doc-only location; the route implementation is not in this file. Keep the new section next to the other gateway passthrough sections.
applies: Documentation for MLflow gateway passthrough REST endpoints.
says: Please add the new gateway passthrough route to the REST API reference documentation.
The REST API reference is missing documentation for our new gateway passthrough endpoint.
Our public API docs do not show the endpoint table and model credentials description.
Add an entry for the passthrough endpoint next to the other gateway reference sections.
search: Documenting gateway passthrough endpoints in the REST API reference requires manually adding a section to docs/api_reference/source/rest-api.rst with an anchor label formatted as .. _fastapi<METHOD><path with slashes removed>. Each entry includes a section title, a grid table showing the endpoint in literal backticks, and a description stating the gateway credentials and model used. This guidance applies strictly to documentation in docs/api_reference/source/rest-api.rst beside other gateway passthrough sections, not route implementations.
